# (APPENDIX) Appendix {-}  
  
# Regulator Summary {-}  
  
```{r regulators, echo=FALSE}  
regs <- data.frame(  
  Institution = c("CBN", "NDIC", "SEC", "NAICOM", "IMF"),  
  Domain = c("Banking / monetary policy",  
             "Deposit insurance, bank supervision, liquidation",  
             "Capital market",  
             "Insurance business",  
             "International monetary system"),  
  Established = c("1959 (operations)", "1989 (Decree 22 of 1988)",  
                  "Statutory regulator of the capital market",  
                  "1997 (NAICOM Act No. 1)", "1944/1945 (Bretton Woods)")  
)  
knitr::kable(regs, caption = "Key regulatory institutions",  
             booktabs = TRUE)  
```  
  
See Sections \@ref(sec-cbn), \@ref(sec-ndic), \@ref(sec-sec),  
\@ref(sec-naicom), and \@ref(sec-imf) for details.
